2122051768687174081.en_summary: Tick tock never stops. FT: Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia’s chief executive, as allies in Silicon Valley pressure the company’s board to reinstate him days after the tech executive resigned over reports he had affairs with a suspected Chinese spy and a subordinate. Huang has discussed with confidantes the possibility of returning, according to multiple people familiar with the matter.
2122051768687174081.zh_summary: 滴答滴答永不停止。金融時報：黃仁勳正考慮重返英偉達首席執行官職位，因為矽谷盟友向公司董事會施壓，要求在該科技高管因與疑似中國間諜及下屬有染的報道而辭職數日後恢復其職位。據多名知情人士稱，黃仁勳已與親信討論了返回的可能性。

2122051747677909144.en_summary: Jensen Huang is reportedly considering a comeback as Nvidia’s CEO - FT.
2122051747677909144.zh_summary: 據報導，黃仁勳正考慮重返英偉達首席執行官職位 - 金融時報。

2122050718957789477.en_summary: On one hand tech bros say China doesn't want chips. On the other, Jensen/Sacks & co clearly wanted to ease export controls & send chips to China. Meanwhile, Nvidia chips ended up in China & odds are they sat atop the largest smuggling operation in history.
2122050718957789477.zh_summary: 一方面科技兄弟們說中國不想要芯片。另一方面，黃仁勳/薩克斯等人明顯想放寬出口管制並向中國發送芯片。同時，英偉達芯片最終進入中國，很可能是歷史上最大走私行動的頂點。

2122048667045499369.en_summary: Jensen Huang is considering returning to the head of Nvidia just days after his resignation. According to FT, he discussed it with confidantes, and allies are setting up a war room of Silicon Valley bosses to pressure the board, aiming for White House support. Campaign gained momentum this weekend with Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney supporting the open letter Bring Jensen Back, Nvidia employees signing publicly, and major shareholders Brad Gerstner and Gavin Baker asking the board to keep all options open including his return. Scott Bessent demands a big cleanup at Nvidia head, board conducting independent investigation. Jensen has only about 3.4% capital control so cannot override board. Rene Haas of Arm reportedly approached as successor. Real issue for market is compliance of chip sales in Asia under scrutiny, some say inflated Asia numbers. All this two days before earnings Tuesday with Colette Kress interim and Anthropic IPO Thursday amid tense macro and politics. A $4T company whose founder might return a week after leaving, unprecedented scale.
2122048667045499369.zh_summary: 黃仁勳正考慮在辭職僅數日後重返英偉達領導職位。據金融時報，他已與親信討論此事，盟友正在建立矽谷老闆的戰爭室向董事會施壓，目標是獲得白宮支持。本週末運動升溫，埃隆·馬斯克和蒂姆·斯威尼支持公開信《帶回黃仁勳》，英偉達員工公開簽名，主要股東布拉德·格斯特納和加文·貝克要求董事會保留所有選項包括其回歸。斯科特·貝森特要求對英偉達領導層進行大清理，董事會正在進行獨立調查。黃仁勳僅控制約3.4%資本，因此無法凌駕董事會。據報Arm的勒內·哈斯被接觸作為繼任者。對市場而言真正問題是亞洲芯片銷售合規性正受嚴格審查，有人稱亞洲數字被誇大。所有這一切發生在週二業績前兩天，科萊特·克雷斯臨時擔任，以及週四Anthropic IPO，背景是緊張的宏觀與政治。一家4萬億美元公司的創始人可能在離開一週後回歸，前所未見的規模。
